armor.name: Riftguard Vest
armor.effect: After you touch a Rift Shrine, take 20% less damage for 30 s.

armor.name: Moonsilver Mail
armor.effect: +10% move speed; the perfect-dodge window lasts 0.05 s longer.

armor.name: Kinetic Weave
armor.effect: Stores 30% of damage taken; your next melee hit releases it as a pulse (up to 60).

armor.name: Siegeframe Plate
armor.effect: +40% HP and -15% move speed; your melee hits stagger Brutes.

armor.name: Projectile Ward Harness
armor.effect: -50% damage from projectiles, +20% damage taken from melee.

armor.name: Lifeburn Exoframe
armor.effect: Doubles damage and resource gain, but drains 1% HP per second in combat.

armor.name: Living Mantle
armor.effect: A living cloak: blocks one projectile every 5 s and stuns an attacker for 1 s when you're hit.

armor.name: Mirrorplate
armor.effect: Every 6th projectile that hits you is reflected at full damage.

armor.name: Starsteel Plate
armor.effect: -30% damage from projectiles and beams; immune to burning.

armor.name: Starborn Weave
armor.effect: Regenerates 1% HP per second while your resource bar is above half.

armor.name: Nightveil Cloak
armor.effect: Stand still for 1 s to turn invisible; your first hit from invisibility always crits.

armor.name: Quicksilver Plate
armor.effect: Liquid-metal armour that blocks the first hit every 8 s, then reforms.

armor.name: Living Carapace
armor.effect: +20% damage to whichever of melee, shooting or dashing you used most in the last 10 s.

armor.name: Overdrive Exosuit
armor.effect: +50% damage and +30% HP, but drains 2 resource per second in combat; at zero you move 50% slower for 5 s.

armor.name: Seer's Regalia
armor.effect: +40% Arcane and you float over ground hazards, but you can't use consumables while wearing it.

relics.name: Warden's Badge
relics.effect: +10% XP and coin find; your coin Echo shows on the minimap.

relics.name: Field Belt
relics.effect: +1 consumable slot; one consumable charge refills each mission.

relics.name: Shrine Lantern
relics.effect: Each Rift Shrine you touch stores a charge (max 3); spend one to refill your resource bar.

relics.name: Hazard Ward
relics.effect: -50% damage from environmental hazards and ground zones.

relics.name: Clingstep Soles
relics.effect: Immune to knockback and ice; dashing off a wall gives a free second dash.

relics.name: Medic Beads
relics.effect: Potions heal 30% more and cleanse burn and poison.

relics.name: Quickload Bandolier
relics.effect: Active-reload sweet spot is 50% wider; reloads are 30% faster.

relics.name: Analyst Lens
relics.effect: Shows enemy HP numbers and weak elements; +10% crit on a target after aiming at it for 2 s.

relics.name: Dread Sense
relics.effect: Enemy telegraphs appear 0.2 s earlier.

relics.name: Lodestone Bracer
relics.effect: Thrown weapons return 40% faster and drag pickups along their path.

relics.name: Tracker Lens
relics.effect: Shows enemies through walls and hidden caches within 20 m.

relics.name: Hookline Launcher
relics.effect: Dash at a target to grapple to it; small enemies are pulled to you instead.

relics.name: Quickchange Ring
relics.effect: Swap to your second saved loadout instantly, once per room.

relics.name: Echo Stone
relics.effect: When you reclaim your coin Echo, an echo of you fights beside you for 10 s.

relics.name: Ghost Phase
relics.effect: Perfect dodges make you invisible for 2 s.

relics.name: Gale Eye
relics.effect: Your dash releases a wind burst that knocks enemies back.

relics.name: Gambler's Charm
relics.effect: +20 Luck; crits have a 10% chance to drop coins.

relics.name: Heartforge Core
relics.effect: +20% resource regen; energy weapons can't overheat for 3 s after a perfect dodge.

relics.name: Giant's Cinch
relics.effect: +20% Attack; heavy attacks charge 25% faster.

relics.name: Marionette Vein
relics.effect: Hitting a bleeding enemy yanks it 2 m toward you; 5 bleed stacks stun it for 1 s.

relics.name: Dominion Band
relics.effect: Turn invisible for 4 s after each kill; while worn, a Rift Stalker hunts you every 3 minutes.

relics.name: Deepsight Lens
relics.effect: Boss weak points glow 0.5 s before they open and stay open 0.5 s longer.

relics.name: Judgment Seal
relics.effect: Enemies that hit you are marked; your next hit on a marked enemy deals +40%.

relics.name: Farseer Orb
relics.effect: Preview the next room's enemies before you open its door.

relics.name: Ring of Kindling
relics.effect: +20% resource regen. Wearing any 2 Triune rings adds +10% to all stats.

relics.name: Ring of Stillwater
relics.effect: Buffs and consumables last 30% longer. Triune set.

relics.name: Ring of Highwind
relics.effect: Heal 1% HP per second out of combat and 0.3% in combat. Triune set.

relics.name: Kestrel Wings
relics.effect: Dash distance +60%; dashing over gaps and ground hazards is safe.

relics.name: Stormcaller Torc
relics.effect: Every 5th hit calls down a radiant lightning bolt on the target.

relics.name: Twinring
relics.effect: Your dash leaves a rift; dash again within 5 s to return to it.

relics.name: Dawnlight Vial
relics.effect: Raise it with Interact to blind and repel nearby enemies for 3 s (30 s cooldown).

relics.name: Throat of Command
relics.effect: Your parries also stun Minions and Veterans within 4 m for 1 s.

relics.name: Astral Double
relics.effect: Once per room, project a shadow double that taunts enemies for 4 s.

relics.name: Velocity Aura
relics.effect: +15% move speed; after 2 s at full speed, your dash damages everything it passes.

relics.name: Stiltlimb Rig
relics.effect: A mechanical limb strikes any enemy within melee range, once per second.

relics.name: Kinetic Aura
relics.effect: Pick up stunned enemies with Interact and throw them for heavy damage.

relics.name: Wayfinder Cube
relics.effect: Heals are 25% stronger; fast-travel between discovered shrines in the act.

relics.name: Echoing Charm
relics.effect: Abilities have a 15% chance to cast twice.

relics.name: Implant Kit
relics.effect: Your dash fires 4 darts, and you can't be slowed.

relics.name: Deflector Vambraces
relics.effect: Parried projectiles and beams are reflected; two parries within 1 s call down lightning.

relics.name: Gorgon Mirror
relics.effect: Raise it to petrify Minions in a cone for 2 s; petrified enemies shatter for +50% damage.

relics.name: Ancestor's Wrath
relics.effect: Below 25% HP your ultimate meter fills 3x faster, and your ultimate heals 30%.

relics.name: Rimecrown
relics.effect: All hits chill (15% slow); every 60 s a blizzard pulse freezes nearby enemies for 1 s.

relics.name: Nova Heart
relics.effect: With a full ultimate meter, detonate it for a screen-wide blast; your stats drop 30% for 20 s afterwards.

relics.name: Haven Bubble
relics.effect: Hold Parry for 1 s to raise a bubble that blocks all damage for 2 s (30 s cooldown).

relics.name: Bloodless Scabbard
relics.effect: Immune to damage over time. With the Sovereign Blade: +25% damage.

relics.name: Skinthief Core
relics.effect: Absorb the form of a Champion you defeat; once per room, become it for 10 s.

relics.name: Turnback Hourglass
relics.effect: Once per room, rewind 3 s: you return to where you were, with the HP you had.

relics.name: Hollow Core
relics.effect: Holds up to four Realm Shards and grants all their powers at once.

relics.name: Ironheart Shard
relics.effect: Earth shard: +25% damage; every 10th hit releases a shockwave.

relics.name: Ember Shard
relics.effect: Abyss shard: kills heal 2% HP; slain Elites rise as spirit allies for 15 s.

relics.name: Dawn Shard
relics.effect: Empyrean shard: an Elite you parry fights for you for 10 s.

relics.name: Null Shard
relics.effect: Void shard: your dash blinks through walls; once per room, every enemy projectile on screen turns into coins.

consumables.name: Minor Healing Draught
consumables.effect: Heals 30% HP over 2 s.

consumables.name: Resource Tonic
consumables.effect: Refills 50% of your resource bar.

consumables.name: Greater Healing Draught
consumables.effect: Heals 60% HP instantly.

consumables.name: Bridge Sigil
consumables.effect: Return to the hub, then come back to the same shrine.

consumables.name: Moonroot Tonic
consumables.effect: For 60 s, hidden enemies show on the minimap and you move 15% faster.

consumables.name: Override Key
consumables.effect: Hacks an enemy turret or drone to fight for you for 15 s, or opens a locked vault.

consumables.name: Seeker's Map
consumables.effect: For one mission, every enemy and every Mimic chest shows on the minimap.

consumables.name: Shadowcap Lantern
consumables.effect: Darkens the room for 3 s; ranged enemies can't target you.

consumables.name: Viper Needle
consumables.effect: Your next hit poisons for 10% of the target's max HP over 6 s.

consumables.name: Jury-Rigged Bomb
consumables.effect: A huge blast, but 1 in 5 fizzle.

consumables.name: Prime Serum
consumables.effect: For 30 s: +20% damage, +20% move speed and steady HP regen.

consumables.name: Chainward Talisman
consumables.effect: Binds the target in chains for 3 s (1 s on bosses).

consumables.name: Banegas Grenade
consumables.effect: Enemies in the cloud take 25% more damage from every element for 6 s.

consumables.name: Seafire Flask
consumables.effect: Thrown flask; its fire burns for 6 s, spreads, and keeps burning on water.

consumables.name: Whisper Talisman
consumables.effect: Turns 3 nearby Minions or Veterans against their allies for 8 s.

consumables.name: Errand Cube
consumables.effect: Summons an imp that fights until it lands 10 hits, then vanishes.

consumables.name: Spirit Jar
consumables.effect: Instantly traps a spirit enemy below 25% HP; trapped Elites drop double loot.

consumables.name: Howl Vial
consumables.effect: A scream that stuns nearby enemies for 2 s and breaks their shields.

consumables.name: Mindflash
consumables.effect: A blinding flash stuns every enemy on screen for 1 s and resets their aggro.

consumables.name: Sunseed Grenade
consumables.effect: An expanding sphere hits everything inside very hard, then stops cleanly at its edge.

consumables.name: Pocket Hole
consumables.effect: Throw it on the floor; Minions that walk in drop out of the fight.
